chapter: Joe Liggins and back to Kid Ory
title: Bud Scott and which Bud Scott
summary: They sort out the two banjo players named Bud Scott and Joe rates Bud as the best musician in the Ory band.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Now, let me ask you something about Bud Scott. There were two Bud Scotts.
There was a Bud Scott from Memphis that played banjo.
Was that the same one that was from Natchez?
Natchez. Now you've got it. It wasn't Memphis; it was Natchez. People got the two mixed up.
They've always been mixing those two people up. But Bud was actually from New Orleans.

That's right. It wasn't Natchez. You'd mention that to Bud Scott, and Bud would say, 'No, man, I ain't from Natchez. That fella in Natchez can't play nothin.' 'I'm the original,' he used to tell you. 'I'm from New Orleans.'
A few of the people who played with Ory, I think Teddy Buckner...I'm not sure... Teddy Buckner, definitely Blakeney, and Tudie, who I spoke to, they claim Bud Scott was the best musician in the band.
Bud Scott was a good musician.
Would you say he was the best in the band?

I would think so. Buster Wilson was a pretty good musician, too. He read real good. But he was by far the musician in the band after... Well, he was a better musician than Buster, too, for that matter.

Like on the records and TV things and the movie films I've seen of Bud, they're few and far between and there's not many of them... But he doesn't impress you that he's a great musician. He's a very simple player, you know.

And on that thing with Louis, where the Blues was born in New Orleans, and here's the man with the big cigar, and he's just strumming DOODLE-UM-DUM-DUM -- real simple stuff. You'd never believe that he knew much about the instrument. He just seemed to me just another one of those large Marrero type... You know, read chord things, but...
Well, he played a little more than that.
Well, he must have done it with all those people. Because Blakeney is a good musician, and he swears by Bud Scott.
Yeah, Bud Scott was a good musician.
